For every integer $n \ge 5$, $2 \sum F_{k_1} T_{k_2} Q_{k_3} P_{k_4} = P_{n+4} - P_{n+3} + P_{n+2} + T_{n+3} + T_{n+1} - F_n - 2Q_{n+3} - 2Q_{n+1}$, where the sum runs over all $4$-tuples $(k_1, k_2, k_3, k_4)$ of nonnegative integers with $k_1 + k_2 + k_3 + k_4 = n - 5$.
nodes.title: Four-fold convolution of the Fibonacci, tribonacci, tetranacci and pentanacci numbers

nodes.summary: Write $\mathcal{P}_n$ for the Pell numbers, $F_n$ for the Fibonacci numbers and $T_n$ for the tribonacci numbers (the Fibonacci $m$-step numbers $F^{(m)}_n$ with $m = 2$ and $m = 3$). For every integer $n \ge 0$, $2 \sum \mathcal{P}_{k_1} F_{k_2} T_{k_3} = \mathcal{P}_{n+1} - T_{n+3} - T_{n+2} + 2F_{n+2}$, where the sum runs over all triples $(k_1, k_2, k_3)$ of nonnegative integers with $k_1 + k_2 + k_3 = n$.
nodes.title: Closed form for the Pell–Fibonacci–tribonacci triple convolution

nodes.summary: Write $T_n$, $Q_n$ and $P_n$ for the Fibonacci $m$-step numbers $F^{(m)}_n$ with $m = 3, 4, 5$ respectively. For every integer $n \ge 7$, $2 \sum T_{k_1} Q_{k_2} P_{k_3} = P_n + P_{n-2} + P_{n-4} + T_n - T_{n-2} - 2Q_n$, where the sum runs over all triples $(k_1, k_2, k_3)$ of nonnegative integers with $k_1 + k_2 + k_3 = n - 7$.
nodes.title: Triple convolution of the tribonacci, tetranacci and pentanacci numbers

nodes.summary: Write $F_n$ for the Fibonacci numbers and $P_n$ for the pentanacci numbers (the Fibonacci $m$-step numbers $F^{(m)}_n$ with $m = 2$ and $m = 5$). For every integer $n \ge 0$, $2 \sum_{j=0}^{n} F_j P_{n-j} = P_{n+2} + P_{n-1} - F_{n+2}$, where $P_{n-1}$ is read as $P_0 = 0$ when $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Convolution of the Fibonacci and pentanacci numbers

nodes.summary: Write $J_n$ for the Jacobsthal numbers ($J_0 = 0$, $J_1 = 1$, $J_{n+2} = J_{n+1} + 2J_n$) and $T_n$ for the tribonacci numbers (the Fibonacci $3$-step numbers $F^{(3)}_n$). For every integer $n \ge 0$, $2 \sum_{j=0}^{n} J_j T_{n-j} = 2J_{n+1} + J_{n+2} - T_{n+3} - T_{n+1}$.
nodes.title: Convolution of the Jacobsthal and tribonacci numbers

nodes.summary: Write $T_n$ for the tribonacci numbers (the Fibonacci $3$-step numbers $F^{(3)}_n$). For every integer $n \ge 0$, $2 \sum_{j=0}^{n} (-1)^j T_j = (-1)^n (T_{n+1} - T_{n-1}) - 1$, where $T_{n-1}$ is read as $T_0 = 0$ when $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Alternating sum of the tribonacci numbers

nodes.summary: Write $P_n$ for the pentanacci numbers and $T_n$ for the tribonacci numbers (the Fibonacci $m$-step numbers $F^{(m)}_n$ with $m = 5$ and $m = 3$). For every integer $n \ge 0$, $2 \sum_{j=0}^{n} P_j T_{n-j} = -P_{n+7} + 2P_{n+6} - P_{n+5} + 2P_{n+4} + P_{n+3} - T_{n+4} + T_{n+2}$.
nodes.title: Convolution of the pentanacci and tribonacci numbers, second closed form

nodes.summary: Write $P_n$ for the pentanacci numbers and $T_n$ for the tribonacci numbers (the Fibonacci $m$-step numbers $F^{(m)}_n$ with $m = 5$ and $m = 3$). For every integer $n \ge 0$, $2 \sum_{j=0}^{n} P_j T_{n-j} = P_{n+3} + P_{n+1} + P_{n-1} - T_{n+3} - T_{n+1}$, where $P_{n-1}$ is read as $P_0 = 0$ when $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Convolution of the pentanacci and tribonacci numbers

Number Theory

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
